items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: He was the one who made Rene, Kid Rene, look like 15 cents.

ctx.x: Well, who was in that, that was Cornbread's band, right? Who was that?

Yeah, Joseph Thomas. Who was in the band? We used a fella called Julius, Julius on banjo, damn good banjo, sort of Jamaica bar. Henry Ricksnell, he's a male carter. He was a good man. He was the one who made Rene, Kid Rene, look like 15 cents. When this number, we got this number before them, music go round and round, because he was a smart fella. He was just like Blue. Of course he's a better man than Blue because anything he wanted, he could read it, you know, hold his up on. But he had a double of a head, you…
